spec: Per COMBAT_AND_CLASS_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md §6.1 — 3 paths × ~27 nodes; 51 points total; tier-N gates at (N-1)*5 points; tier-7 capstone gates at ~31 points; multi-rank passives ~70%; identity/keystone ~30%.
designNotes: Class-First Principle (LOCKED §4.2): class trees are weapon-agnostic. NO weapon-conditional nodes. Tag-conditional nodes (wind-up, single-target, trap, projectile) ARE allowed since tags apply across weapons via morphs.

Idle-game context: no movement/standing mechanics. Snared is action-speed slow on enemy (idle-friendly), not movement-locked. Traps are zone-effects, not tile-based. Companion combat is per-encounter, not pet-positioning.
Multi-rank flavor directive: 15 of 81 nodes (~19%) are pure stat-sticks; the remaining 66 carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor. Within target.
Buff migrations: 0 (Hnt pool not yet authored — no audited active buffs to migrate per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT scope; bow pool is Phase C3 rebuild).
Cross-weapon node: Cross-Weapon Mark (Trapper T6) — Mark & Execute triggers regardless of weapon equipped (per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation).

All 3 capstones reshape Mark & Execute signature: Headhunter (Marksman) makes first hit on new target always crit + doubles Precision Payoff; Pack Leader (Beastmaster) summons permanent companion that inherits Mark application + on-hit procs; Snare Field (Trapper) gives traps +2 arming counts + escalating chain damage.
Base-mechanic dependencies tracked per-node in `dependencies` array.

paths.name: Marksman
paths.theme: Crit-precision axis. First-hit crits, precision payoffs, sniper-cycle. The Headhunter; every encounter opens with a guaranteed crit, then snowballs.

nodes.name: Steady Aim
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% crit chance (foundation).

nodes.name: Hunter's Eye
nodes.description: On Mark application, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to gain a guaranteed-crit charge for the follow-up Precision Payoff.

nodes.name: Precision Tap
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% damage on single-target tagged skills (foundation).

nodes.name: Hunter's Patience
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% damage on first hit on a new target.

nodes.name: Heavy Bolt
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% damage on wind-up tagged skills (Crossbow paradigm support).

nodes.name: Critical Aim
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% crit chance against Marked targets.

nodes.name: Sniper's Tempo
nodes.description: On crit, the consumed skill regains 1/2/3 mana.

nodes.name: Headshot Sense
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% crit damage against Marked targets.

nodes.name: Bleeding Out Mastery
nodes.description: Bleeding Out ticks have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to crit.

nodes.name: Precision Cascade
nodes.description: Precision Payoffs have +10/20/30/40/50% chance to refresh Mark on the target instead of consuming.

nodes.name: Sharpened Bolt
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% crit damage on wind-up tagged skills (Crossbow paradigm support).

nodes.name: Mark Hunter
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% damage to Marked targets (foundation).

nodes.name: Headhunter Preview
nodes.description: First hit on a new target has +20/40/60/80/100% bonus crit chance (preview of Headhunter capstone).

nodes.name: Sniper's Mastery
nodes.description: Single-target crit hits have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to deal triple damage instead of crit damage (replaces flat scaling with spike-proc).

nodes.name: Mark Reset
nodes.description: On crit-killing a Marked target, +20/40/60% chance to instantly Mark all enemies in encounter.

nodes.name: Precision Payoff Mastery
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% damage on Precision Payoff hits (scaling the signature consumer).

nodes.name: Crit Mastery
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% crit chance (foundation).

nodes.name: Mark Echo
nodes.description: On Mark application, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to also apply Tracked.

nodes.name: Sniper's Patience
nodes.description: Wind-up tagged skill cast time -2/4/6/8/10% per second held in encounter (charge-up bonus, max -50% at 5s).

nodes.name: Precision Reaper
nodes.description: On Precision Payoff kill, refund the consumer skill's cooldown completely.

nodes.name: Critical Cycle
nodes.description: On crit, +1/2/3/4/5% chance to instantly Mark another enemy in encounter.

nodes.name: Mark Master
nodes.description: +2/4/6 seconds Mark duration.

nodes.name: Headshot Cascade
nodes.description: Crits against Marked targets have +5/10/15% chance to fire an additional copy of the consumer skill on the same target.

nodes.name: Tracker's Sigil
nodes.description: Tracked enemies always count as Marked for Precision Payoff purposes (cross-state aliasing).

nodes.name: Apex Marksman
nodes.description: +1/2/3% crit chance per Marked enemy in encounter (max +15% with 5 Marked).

nodes.name: Headhunter
nodes.description: First hit on any new target always crits. Precision Payoffs deal +50% damage (stacks with all other Precision Payoff bonuses). (Mirrors §10.1 Marksman ascendancy keystone — reshapes Mark & Execute by guaranteeing the opener crit and doubling the signature payoff.)

nodes.name: Marksman Sovereign
nodes.description: Mark duration +50%. Marked targets you crit cannot have Mark removed by anything other than your skills (lock-in).

paths.name: Beastmaster
paths.theme: Animal-companion axis. Permanent companion as second damage source; companion inherits your procs and Mark application. The Pack; 2-vs-1 fights where your beast does the hunting.

nodes.name: Pack Bond
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% companion damage (foundation).

nodes.name: Companion's Vigor
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% companion HP (foundation).

nodes.name: Hunter's Mark Bond
nodes.description: When you apply Mark, +5/10/15/20/25% chance the companion focuses the Marked target on its next attack.

nodes.name: Pack Hunt
nodes.description: Companion attacks have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Mark (companion as Mark applier).

nodes.name: Hunting Tempo
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% companion attack speed.

nodes.name: Bond of Blood
nodes.description: On Bleeding Out tick, +5/10/15/20/25% chance the companion gains +20% damage for 4s.

nodes.name: Pack Awareness
nodes.description: While companion is alive, +1/2/3/4/5% crit chance.

nodes.name: Pack Tactics
nodes.description: Companion crits have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to also crit your next hit on the same target (player-companion fusion).

nodes.name: Companion's Fury
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% companion damage while you are above 75% HP (rewards low-incoming-damage stance).

nodes.name: Pack's Inheritance
nodes.description: Companion inherits +5/10/15/20/25% of your on-hit procs (preview of Pack Leader capstone).

nodes.name: Hunter's Pact
nodes.description: Bleeding Out ticks on Marked targets refresh companion focus to that target.

nodes.name: Wild Strike
nodes.description: Companion attacks have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Bleeding Out.

nodes.name: Beastmaster's Ferocity
nodes.description: Companion crits have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to land double crits.

nodes.name: Pack Synergy
nodes.description: While companion is alive, +5/10/15/20/25% damage to you.

nodes.name: Hunt Cascade
nodes.description: On companion-killing a Marked target, +20/40/60% chance to apply Mark to all enemies in encounter.

nodes.name: Pack Resilience
nodes.description: Companion has +20/40/60% chance to survive a lethal hit at 1 HP (once per companion lifetime).

nodes.name: Pack Bond Mastery
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% companion damage per Marked enemy in encounter (max +25% with 5 Marked).

nodes.name: Pack Mark
nodes.description: Companion's Mark applications have +25/50/75% chance to also apply Tracked.

nodes.name: Soul Bond
nodes.description: When you crit, companion's next attack gains +50% damage.

nodes.name: Pack Inheritance Mastery
nodes.description: Companion inherits +25/50/75% of your on-hit procs (scaler — stacks with Pack's Inheritance for up to 100%).

nodes.name: Hunter's Loyalty
nodes.description: Companion summon has +5/10/15/20/25% chance to cost 0 mana.

nodes.name: Pack Leader Preview
nodes.description: Companion automatically inherits Mark application from your hits (when you Mark, companion does too).

nodes.name: Pack Sovereign
nodes.description: Companion crits have +20/40/60% chance to crit twice.

nodes.name: Hunt Pact
nodes.description: On companion-kill, +25/50/75% chance to instantly refresh trap cooldowns by 1s.

nodes.name: Bond of Hunting
nodes.description: Companion-applied Marks last forever (no decay) until target dies or another Mark is applied.

nodes.name: Pack Leader
nodes.description: Summon a permanent animal companion (pick wolf/hawk/panther at ascendancy). It inherits your on-hit procs and Mark application in full. (Mirrors §10.1 Beastmaster ascendancy keystone — reshapes Mark & Execute by giving Hunter a second on-Mark applier and a second damage source.)

nodes.name: Beastmaster Sovereign
nodes.description: Companion attacks count as YOUR attacks for Precision Payoff purposes — companion-then-you and you-then-companion both trigger Precision Payoff on Marked targets.

paths.name: Trapper
paths.theme: Trap-stack axis. Multi-arming traps, snare detonations, escalating chain damage. The Setup Master; prep the encounter before it starts, watch the chain detonate.

nodes.name: Trapper's Hand
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% trap-tagged skill damage (foundation).

nodes.name: Quick Reload
nodes.description: Trap cooldowns -2/4/6/8/10% (foundation).

nodes.name: Snare Sense
nodes.description: Snared enemies take +1/2/3/4/5% increased damage from your skills.

nodes.name: Multi-Arming
nodes.description: Traps have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to arm a second time on detonation (Snare Field preview).

nodes.name: Trap Trigger
nodes.description: Hits on trapped enemies have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to trigger the trap immediately.

nodes.name: Snare Mastery
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5 seconds Snare duration.

nodes.name: Heavy Trap
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% trap detonation damage.

nodes.name: Chain Trap
nodes.description: Multi-trap chains' damage escalation +5/10/15/20/25% per chained detonation (preview of Snare Field).

nodes.name: Trapper's Tempo
nodes.description: On trap detonation, +5/10/15/20/25% chance for the next skill cast within 2s to be free (no mana cost).

nodes.name: Snare Crit
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% crit chance against Snared targets.

nodes.name: Trap Stack
nodes.description: +1/2/3 maximum traps active (raises trap cap).

nodes.name: Pierce Trap
nodes.description: Pierce-tagged shots on trapped enemies have +20/40/60/80/100% chance to detonate the trap.

nodes.name: Snare Cascade
nodes.description: On trap detonation hitting multiple enemies, all hit gain Snared.

nodes.name: Trap Pulse
nodes.description: Active traps emit a Snare pulse every 2 seconds applying Snared to nearest enemy.

nodes.name: Snare Detonation Mastery
nodes.description: Trap detonations have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to fire twice.

nodes.name: Mark Trap
nodes.description: Trap detonations against Marked targets refund 1/2/3/4/5% of trap cooldown immediately.

nodes.name: Trap Reservoir
nodes.description: +2/4/6 maximum traps active (stacks with Trap Stack).

nodes.name: Snare Bound
nodes.description: Each Snared enemy in encounter grants +1/2/3/4/5% damage.

nodes.name: Chain Reaction
nodes.description: Trap detonations have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to trigger nearby active traps.

nodes.name: Mark Trap Cascade
nodes.description: Killing a trapped+Marked enemy refunds all trap cooldowns by 0.5/1/1.5/2/2.5s.

nodes.name: Trap Crit
nodes.description: Trap detonations have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to crit at +50% bonus crit damage.

nodes.name: Cross-Weapon Mark
nodes.description: Mark & Execute triggers regardless of weapon equipped. Any first hit, any weapon, applies Mark; any follow-up from a different skill triggers Precision Payoff. (Per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation — primary cross-weapon node for Hnt.)

nodes.name: Trap Sovereignty
nodes.description: Snared enemies take +5/10/15% additional damage from your skills (stacks with Snare Sense).

nodes.name: Pulse Mastery
nodes.description: Trap Pulse (T4 node) applies Snared to all enemies in encounter, not just nearest.

nodes.name: Snare Bloom
nodes.description: On killing a Snared enemy, +25/50/75% chance to spawn a Snare-pulse to all enemies in encounter dealing 50% trap damage.

nodes.name: Snare Field
nodes.description: Traps gain +2 arming counts (default 1). Multi-trap chains deal escalating damage per hit (1×, 1.5×, 2×, 2.5×). (Mirrors §10.1 Trapper ascendancy keystone — reshapes Mark & Execute by adding the trap-chain payoff axis: prep-then-detonate scales harder than reactive Marking.)

nodes.name: Trapper Sovereign
nodes.description: Trap detonations always crit when target is Marked. Each chained trap detonation refunds 0.5s on all skill cooldowns.

categoryDistribution._note: Multi-rank flavor distribution: 66 of 81 nodes (~81%) carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor; 15 (~19%) are pure stat-sticks. Within target. Hnt has the most balanced category split of the 5 classes — 35 procs (heavy on Mark/Trap/Companion event reactions). All 3 tier-7 capstones reshape Mark & Execute signature.
categoryDistribution.balancedSplit: proc/conditional/stat/identity = 35/15/15/15 — clean third-third-third on the non-proc axes.

engineHookDistribution.note: Phase C engineering: each unique engineHook needs an event-emit point. Hnt-specific hooks: onMarkApply, onPrecisionPayoff, onTrapDetonate, onTrapChain, onCompanionAttack, onCompanionCrit, onCompanionKill, onCompanionSummon, onCompanionLethalHit, companionProcInheritance, onFirstHitOnTarget.
engineHookDistribution.uniqueHooks: ~36 unique engineHook patterns across 81 nodes; companion- and trap-specific events form the heaviest infrastructure burden.
